Maya (People Ops): FYI we have an oversize crate at the curb for a visitor. No courier label, just a handwritten note "installation piece". 
Ethan: on my way down with a dolly. which entrance should I use? :running_man:
Maya (People Ops): use loading dock B pls. tell them not to leave it in the lobby — it's too big and the frame is fragile.
Front Desk Bot: Visitor arrival recorded: Jordan Alvarez, arrival 09:40. Badge not printed (printer out of paper).
Sophie: I can free up the gallery area by the atrium for them to set up if they need space.
Tomas: grabbed the crate. courier was a local rider who said "left with visitor". no company name. crate has "handle top" and a sticky that says "please uncrate on soft surface". photos uploaded.
delivery-bot: courier event logged at 09:42 from "LocalArtDrop" (manifest missing).
Maya (People Ops): leaving a manual badge slot on the tablet. I'll meet them at loading dock in 10. temporary badge will be issued with visitor constraints.
Facilities Bot: loading dock B gate opened remotely at 09:45 for 15 minutes.
Ethan: pro tip for the day: bring a blanket for delicate frames. I wrapped corners with spare bubble wrap from the storage closet.
Sophie: set aside seating in the atrium and moved potted plant to give more room. :seedling:
Maya (People Ops): badge issued manually at 09:52. Badge ID: TEMP-7853. Access limited to loading dock, atrium gallery, and restroom.
Tomas: crate staged in gallery area per request. security will scan the item and hold until the artist signs a release.
Ethan: also — Jordan smelled like coffee and success. someone bring them a coffee? :coffee:
Maya (People Ops): haha noted. closing loop — added a checklist item to the front desk SOP: check for courier name on handwritten slips and replenish badge printer paper daily. Thanks team!
